title: Randolph AFB 'accelerated learning' Skinner box program
place_text: Randolph Air Force Base, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: they said to the parents that it was an accelerated learning program with for children with very very high IQs

plain: In 1952, at Randolph Air Force Base, a military base in San Antonio, Texas, children were put through a program built around Skinner boxes, closed boxes used to train behaviour through reward and punishment. Whitley Strieber, an author who has written about his own encounters with strange beings, tells this from what a person he knows told him. He says the parents were told "it was an accelerated learning program" for "children with very very high IQs," and he tells it as a hint that the military was secretly testing gifted children.
